data.long_meaning: The name Ellsworth comes from Old English words ‘Elf’ meaning ‘elf’ or ‘stranger’ and ‘worth’ meaning ‘fort’ or ‘enclosure’. The name has been used since the Middle Ages and was popularized in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. Ellsworth can be seen as a symbol of protection, strength, and otherworldliness. The name Ellsworth carries the meaning “Elf or stranger's fort” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ellsworth usually hope their child will grow to embody elf or stranger's fort and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אלסוורת'

in_greek.name: Ελσουορθ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι η δύναμή μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ελσουορθ προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα και συντίθεται από το 'El' που σημαίνει Θεός και το 'sworth' που σημαίνει δύναμη ή ισχύς, επομένως το Ελσουορθ μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως 'Ο Θεός είναι η δύναμή μου' ή 'Η δύναμη του Θεού', αντανακλώντας την πίστη και την εξάρτηση από τον Θεό ως πηγή δύναμης και ισχύος.

in_latin.name: Ellsworth
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ellsworth ex lingua anglica derivatum est et componitur ex 'El' quod significat Deum et 'sworth' quod significat fortitudinem seu potentiam, ergo Ellsworth interpretari potest ut 'Deus est mea fortitudo' vel 'Fortitudo Dei', reflectens fidem et dependentiam a Deo ut fonte virium et potentiae.

in_english.name: Ellsworth

Historically, it has been used in Christian traditions to signify one's faith and dependence on divine power.
